title: Sports Endeavors
description:
Sports Endeavors is a North Carolina company founded in 1984 by brothers Mike and Brendan Moylan. It owns Soccer.com, WorldSoccerShop, and 431 Sports, selling uniforms, gear, and apparel for soccer, baseball, softball, and volleyball to teams, players, and fans. The company is known for a large selection from brands such as Nike, adidas, and Puma, plus custom team uniforms. In April 2026 it was acquired by Varsity Brands / BSN SPORTS.
https://www.sportsendeavors.com/
